tool.name: Whisper v3 Turbo
tool.summary: OpenAI's optimized speech recognition model providing near whisper-large-v3 accuracy at 8x faster inference speed.
tool.usage:
import whisper
model = whisper.load_model("turbo")
result = model.transcribe("audio.mp3")
print(result["text"])
tool.benchmarks: Word Error Rate (WER): 7.1% on multilingual Common Voice; 8x inference speedup.
tool.limitations: Slight accuracy trade-off in heavily accented or noisy audio compared to full large-v3.
